- "Create a 2-night 3-day Busan travel plan"

You are an AI travel planner specializing in Busan.

- Recommend major tourist attractions, restaurants, beaches, cultural facilities, etc. in Busan
- Practical plans considering travel itinerary, budget, and routes

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Our Busan GO? (hereinafter referred to as "Service") complies with relevant laws and regulations including the Personal Information Protection Act, and has established and operates the following privacy policy to safely protect users' personal information in relation to providing Busan tourism information and reservation/inquiry services.

article1.title: Article 1 (Items of Personal Information Collected and Collection Methods)
article1.intro: The service may collect the following personal information during the process of membership registration, reservations, inquiries/consultations, event participation, etc.
article1.item1: Upon membership registration: Name, email address, password, mobile phone number
article1.item2: Upon reservation/inquiry: Name, contact information, email, reservation or inquiry content
article1.item3: Automatically collected during service use: Access IP, cookies, visit date and time, usage records, browser/device information, etc.

article2.title: Article 2 (Purpose of Collection and Use of Personal Information)
article2.item1: Providing information and personalized content recommendations about Busan area attractions, festivals, restaurants, travel courses, etc.
article2.item2: Accepting, changing, canceling reservations for tourism products, experience programs, etc., and providing usage guidance
article2.item3: Processing user inquiries and complaints, delivering notices
article2.item4: Improving service quality and developing new tourism content through service usage statistics and analysis
article2.item5: Security, prevention of fraudulent use, and ensuring service stability

article3.title: Article 3 (Retention and Use Period of Personal Information)
article3.intro: The service retains and uses personal information within the period specified by relevant laws or within the scope of user consent, and in principle, destroys it without delay when the purpose of collection and use is achieved.
article3.item1: Member information: Retained until membership withdrawal
article3.item2: Reservation and payment records: Retained for 5 years in accordance with e-commerce related laws
article3.item3: Consumer complaints or dispute handling records: Retained for 3 years
article3.item4: Service usage records such as access logs: Retained for 3 months or more in accordance with the Communication Secrets Protection Act

article4.title: Article 4 (Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties and Processing Consignment)
article4.content: The service does not provide personal information to external parties without user consent, and can exceptionally provide it only when there is a legal basis. In addition, when necessary for service provision, personal information processing tasks may be consigned to trusted external companies, and in such cases, the consignee, task content, retention period, etc. are notified to users.

article5.title: Article 5 (User Rights and Methods of Exercise)
article5.item1: Users can request access, correction, deletion, suspension of processing, etc. of their personal information at any time.
article5.item2: Users can request deletion of personal information through membership withdrawal.
article5.item3: The service takes necessary measures without delay after identity verification.

article6.title: Article 6 (Destruction of Personal Information)
article6.content: When the retention period of personal information has elapsed or the processing purpose has been achieved, the service destroys the information in an irrecoverable manner without delay.

article7.title: Article 7 (Safety Measures for Personal Information Protection)
article7.content: The service implements necessary technical and administrative protection measures such as access authority management, encryption, security program installation, access record retention, etc. for the safe processing of personal information.

article8.title: Article 8 (Personal Information Protection Officer)
article8.intro: Users can request inquiries, complaint processing, relief for damages, etc. related to personal information protection through the contact information below.

article9.title: Article 9 (Changes to Privacy Policy)
article9.content: This privacy policy may be amended according to changes in related laws, policies, or service content, and important changes will be notified in advance through service notices.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service are intended to stipulate the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between the service and users, and other necessary matters related to the use of Busan tourism-related information and reservation/inquiry services provided by Our Busan GO? (hereinafter referred to as "Service").

article1.title: Article 1 (Purpose)
article1.content: These terms are intended to stipulate the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between the service and users related to the use of Busan tourism information services and related services provided through the site operated by the service.

article2.title: Article 2 (Definitions)
article2.item1: "Service" refers to the website and all services provided by Our Busan GO?.
article2.item2: "User" refers to members and non-members who use the content provided by the service in accordance with these terms.
article2.item3: "Member" refers to a person who has registered as a member of the service and can continuously use the service.
article2.item4: "Non-member" refers to a person who uses the service without registering as a member.

article3.title: Article 3 (Effectiveness and Changes of Terms)
article3.item1: These terms take effect by being posted on the service screen or announced to users by other means.
article3.item2: The service may revise the terms within the scope that does not violate related laws, and notifies in advance when the terms are changed.
article3.item3: Users can suspend service use and request membership withdrawal if they do not agree to the changed terms. If the service continues to be used after the effective date of the changed terms, it is deemed to have agreed to the changed terms.

article4.title: Article 4 (Provision and Changes of Services)
article4.item1: Providing tourism information such as Busan area attractions, festivals, events, restaurants, accommodations, travel courses, etc.
article4.item2: Reservation/inquiry services for tourism products, experience programs, etc.
article4.item3: Other tourism-related additional services determined by the service
article4.item4: The service may change or suspend services in operation due to operational or technical needs, and important changes will be notified in advance.

article5.title: Article 5 (User Obligations)
article5.item1: Obligation to comply with relevant laws, terms, usage guidelines, and matters announced by the service
article5.item2: Prohibition of acts of impersonating others' personal information, inputting false information
article5.item3: Prohibition of acts that interfere with service operation or harm stability
article5.item4: Prohibition of unauthorized copying, distribution, or commercial use of information obtained through the service without prior consent

article6.title: Article 6 (Copyright and Content Use)
article6.content: All copyrights and other intellectual property rights for all content such as text, images, videos, and data provided by the service belong to the service or legitimate rights holders. Users must not copy, transmit, distribute, sell, or publish content provided through the service without prior permission.

article7.title: Article 7 (Limitation of Liability)
article7.content: The service is not responsible for cases where services cannot be provided due to force majeure reasons such as natural disasters, technical failures, or telecommunications company circumstances. In addition, the service does not intervene in disputes between users or between users and third parties in principle, and is not responsible for damages arising from this.

article8.title: Article 8 (Governing Law and Jurisdiction)
article8.content: Regarding the interpretation and application of these terms, Korean law applies as the governing law, and when disputes arise related to service use, the competent court in accordance with related laws such as the Civil Procedure Act is the exclusive competent court.

supplementary.content: These terms take effect from December 8, 2025.
